sheetIntros.platformGeneralIntro: GetPlaced is engineered for students who refuse to leave their placement preparation to chance. Rather than juggling disconnected bookmarks and messy spreadsheets, this tracker keeps your entire problem-solving roadmap focused in one spot. Every problem you check off is preserved directly in your browser, guaranteeing your progress is right where you left it tomorrow. Choose a sheet below, knock out today's quota, and build the confidence required to clear technical interviews.

striver-a2z-dsa-sheet.intro: Track your progress through the comprehensive DSA roadmap designed by Striver (TakeUForward). GetPlaced organizes all 455 problems into clear milestones with direct links and YouTube walkthroughs, storing every solved checkmark on your device so you never lose your place.
striver-a2z-dsa-sheet.attribution: Curated by Striver (TakeUForward) • Tracked on GetPlaced • 455 Problems

love-babbar-dsa-sheet.intro: Execute the classic 450-problem interview checklist curated by Love Babbar. Tailored specifically for high-yield placement drives, GetPlaced tracks your journey topic by topic so you stay accountable from day one through offer day.
love-babbar-dsa-sheet.attribution: Curated by Love Babbar • Tracked on GetPlaced • 430 Problems

neetcode-dsa-sheet.intro: Tackle the industry-standard 150-question collection curated by NeetCode. Covering every high-frequency pattern tested by top tech firms, GetPlaced gives you a distraction-free checklist to conquer the essentials with speed.
neetcode-dsa-sheet.attribution: Curated by NeetCode • Tracked on GetPlaced • 150 Problems

rohit-negi-dsa-sheet.intro: Work through the in-depth 700+ problem syllabus curated by Rohit Negi (Coder Army). GetPlaced keeps this rigorous, zero-to-hero curriculum structured and bite-sized, tracking your problem-solving stamina as you climb from basics to advanced algorithms.
rohit-negi-dsa-sheet.attribution: Curated by Rohit Negi (Coder Army) • Tracked on GetPlaced • 726 Problems

shradha-khapra-dsa-sheet.intro: Follow the structured problem compilation curated by Shradha Khapra (Apna College). GetPlaced turns this beginner-to-placement curriculum into an intuitive daily tracker with difficulty filters, instant search, and personal revision notes.
shradha-khapra-dsa-sheet.attribution: Curated by Shradha Khapra (Apna College) • Tracked on GetPlaced • 403 Problems

fraz-dsa-sheet.intro: Grind through the high-impact problem set curated by Mohammad Fraz. Focused strictly on core placement patterns, GetPlaced helps you track your weak areas and turn them into strengths before technical interviews.
fraz-dsa-sheet.attribution: Curated by Mohammad Fraz • Tracked on GetPlaced • 279 Problems

arsh-goyal-dsa-sheet.intro: Master the popular placement question set curated by Arsh Goyal. GetPlaced tracks your completion rates across every phase so you walk into campus and off-campus drives with complete confidence.
